answer: The velvet counter is kept in nectar and summit makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 36 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 36 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Every extra alias adds 13 hours of verification and 8 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
